results.pair_summary: Doc A defines Phase C (Semantic Interpretation), mapping Projection Models and ABIs to Semantic Models. Doc B defines Phase D (Graph Construction), structuring Semantic Models into Relational Graphs. They represent sequential, non-overlapping stages in the IR pipeline sharing state definitions but distinct operational scopes.
results.integration_rationale: These specifications define sequential dependencies within the Delta3 Kernel's IR pipeline. Phase C produces the SemanticModel (S) required by Phase D to generate the RelationalGraph (G). Merging them would violate separation of concerns between semantic interpretation and structural graph topology generation.
